name: N_Days
description: number of days between registration and the earlier of death, transplantation, or study analysis time in July 1986

name: Status
description: status of the patient C (censored), CL (censored due to liver tx), or D (death)

name: Drug
description: type of drug D-penicillamine or placebo

name: Ascites
description: presence of ascites N (No) or Y (Yes)

name: Hepatomegaly
description: presence of hepatomegaly N (No) or Y (Yes)

name: Spiders
description: presence of spiders N (No) or Y (Yes)

name: Edema
description: presence of edema N (no edema and no diuretic therapy for edema), S (edema present without diuretics, or edema resolved by diuretics), or Y (edema despite diuretic therapy)
